data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2017 were $230.962m. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2011-2015) show a net adverse development of approximately $9.5m (about 4.1% of opening reserves), representing an overall strengthening of prior year reserves. The movement reflects adverse claims development primarily in Property (habitational/weather-related losses) and is compounded by reinsurance and reinstatement interactions. The report also documents major 2017 catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexican earthquakes) which materially affected the 2017 calendar year result but are separate from the prior-year reserve adjustments.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of $5,582,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year (2016: release $3,362,000).

The 2017 results reflect a number of catastrophe losses in the third quarter. Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria hit the Caribbean and the US. In addition there were two Mexican earthquakes in September.
These were predominantly property losses which hit the Property Direct & Facultative ("Property D&F") and Property Binding Authority classes.
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date and includes IBNR.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: two data points exist that differ. The notes state a 'deterioration of $5,582,000' (phrase in report) but do not explicitly label it gross vs net; a gross claims development triangle is present and was used to compute a gross PYD of ~$9.5m (preferred gross source). The $5.582m statement appears within the 'net claims incurred' paragraph and may be net of reinsurance. The prior_year_development_gbp_m reported here is the triangle-derived gross figure; the report's explicit $5.582k deterioration is retained verbatim in exact_reserve_text to show the discrepancy. All monetary inputs converted from $'000 in report tables to millions. Some LOB-level PYD amounts are not separately quantified in the report and are therefore null.
